interpretations: For each patient identified by (`ID`, `SEX`) with matching lab records, average their nonmissing `ALB` values and their computable per-test `UN`/`T-BIL` ratios; then average those patient-level values within each sex, giving each patient equal weight. Return sexes whose `ALB` average exceeds the mean of the nonmissing sex-level `ALB` averages, along with the sex, both averages, and the unrounded difference.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.ALB) AS alb_avg,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN l.UN IS NOT NULL AND l."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL AND l."T-BIL" <> 0
            THEN l.UN / l."T-BIL"
        END) AS ratio_avg
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(alb_avg) AS alb_avg,
        AVG(ratio_avg) AS ratio_avg
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    alb_avg,
    ratio_avg,
    alb_avg - (SELECT AVG(alb_avg) FROM sex_averages) AS difference
FROM sex_averages
WHERE alb_avg > (SELECT AVG(alb_avg) FROM sex_averages)
